text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after a regional event...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature, have you decided on your plans
after we
check out? There's still some
time before we
board the bullet train.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I haven't really given it much
thought.
Shopping for souvenirs, I guess.
What about you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll tour a few sightseeing
locations. You're
welcome to join me if
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so I get to go on one of your famous
"Ikuno
tours" I've heard about! I'd be
more than happy to
join you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Helios talked about how thorough you
are
researching areas and serving as a
guide during
trips.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's something people talk about?
Well, I hope
I can meet your
expectations...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My first idea was to learn about this
region's
writing and history with a tour
through its museum
of literature and its
castle. For lunch, my
recommendation is
to eat the local specialty,
beef udon
noodles.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Next, we could walk through the many
shopping
districts. They're all unique in
their own right, not
to mention the
nearby udon and yaki udon
restaurants.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, shopping! That part has my name
written all
over it. I bet this'll save me
from the
embarrassment of buying a
souvenir too similar to
someone else's.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If that's your concern, why don't we
choose a
place with a variety of shops?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But let's take care of our stomachs first.
First stop
is udon, followed by some yaki
udon to top it off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What? Weren't you interested in the
food? We
should have a taste of the
local dishes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure these restaurants aren't as strict
with their
rules. We could split one or
ask for half the
normal serving.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'll do all the negotiations.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'll take you up on your word.
Now then,
let's tour some udon shops!
